Use this template to submit a new article. Submissions are moderated first and are not auto-published.

Required fields: `title`, `url`.
Recommended fields: `source`, `language`, `country`.

```yaml
title: "<Article title>"
source: "<Source name>"
url: "https://example.com/article"
language: "nb"
country: "NO"
requested_action: "add"
submitted_from: "index-news-form"
```

Moderation rules:
- Verify source quality and topical relevance (Bovaer/GMO/insect meal/food traceability).
- Keep viewpoint diversity; do not remove competing viewpoints without policy basis.
- Publish only after manual review.
